results.question: What did I spend on groceries in the second half of 2025?
results.sql:
SELECT
  'Groceries total' AS group_name,
  ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE
  amount < 0
  AND category = 'Groceries'
  AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-12-31'
UNION ALL
SELECT
  COALESCE(subcategory, 'Unspecified') AS group_name,
  ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE
  amount < 0
  AND category = 'Groceries'
  AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY
  group_name
LIMIT 200
notes: request: Total spending on Groceries (all subcategories: Supermarket, Bakery, Drugstore) in the second half of 2025, i.e. bookings dated from 2025-07-01 to 2025-12-31, as a total and also broken down per subcategory.

results.question: Did I get any refunds in 2025?
results.sql:
SELECT
  id AS booking_id,
  booked_on AS date,
  description,
  counterparty,
  category,
  ROUND(amount, 2) AS amount_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE
  booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  AND (
    LOWER(description) LIKE '%rueckerstattung%'
    OR LOWER(description) LIKE '%erstattung%'
    OR LOWER(description) LIKE '%refund%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%rueckerstattung%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%erstattung%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%refund%'
  )
ORDER BY
  booked_on
LIMIT 200
notes: request: List all refunds in 2025: find every booking from 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31 with category Income and subcategory Refunds, showing id, date, description, counterparty and amount, plus the total of these refund amounts.

request: Find bookings in 2025 (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31) whose description or counterparty contains the word "Rückerstattung", "Erstattung" or "Refund", showing id, date, description, counterparty, category and amount for each, plus the total amount of those rows.

results.question: Wie viel habe ich letzten Monat pro Woche im Schnitt ausgegeben?

  ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur,
  ROUND(-SUM(amount) / (
    30.0 / 7
  ), 2) AS avg_per_week_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE

LIMIT 200
notes: request: Gesamtausgaben im November 2025 (alle Ausbuchungen mit negativem Betrag vom 01.11.2025 bis 30.11.2025) und der durchschnittliche Wochenausgang in diesem Monat, berechnet als Gesamtsumme geteilt durch die Anzahl Wochen im November (Kalendertage dividiert durch 7).

results.question: Compare what I spent on groceries and on dining per quarter in 2025 as grouped bars.
results.sql:
SELECT
  SUBSTRING(booked_on, 1, 4) || '-Q' || (
    (
      CAST(STRFTIME('%m', booked_on) AS INTEGER) - 1
    ) / 3 + 1
  ) AS quarter,
  category AS topic,
  ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE
  amount < 0
  AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  AND category IN ('Groceries', 'Dining')
GROUP BY
  quarter,
  topic
ORDER BY
  quarter,
  topic
LIMIT 200
notes: request: Compare total spending in 2025, grouped by quarter (Q1–Q4), for the two categories Groceries and Dining side by side as grouped bars: one bar per category within each quarter, amounts in EUR.

results.question: Zeig den Anteil der groessten Haendler an meinen Ausgaben 2025 als Donut.
results.sql:
SELECT
  merchant,
  ROUND(SUM(total_eur), 2) AS total_eur
FROM (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(title, counterparty, description) AS merchant,
    -SUM(amount) AS total_eur
  FROM transaction_view
  WHERE
    amount < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY
    merchant
  HAVING
    COUNT(*) > 1 OR ABS(SUM(amount)) > 1000
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'Sonstige',
    -SUM(amount)
  FROM transaction_view
  WHERE
    amount < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY
    COALESCE(title, counterparty, description)
  HAVING
    COUNT(*) <= 1 AND ABS(SUM(amount)) <= 1000
)
GROUP BY
  merchant
ORDER BY
  total_eur DESC
LIMIT 200
notes: request: Anteil der größten Händler an den Ausgaben des Jahres 2025 (01.01.2025 bis 31.12.2025): Gesamtausgaben pro Händler, nur Ausgaben (negative Beträge), nach Betrag absteigend, Top-Händler plus Rest gesammelt, als Donut-Chart mit Anteilen

results.question: Du hast mir das Jahreseinkommen genannt und danach die Ausgaben pro Kategorie. Zeig mir jetzt als Fluss, wie das Einkommen 2025 in diese Kategorien laeuft.
results.sql:
SELECT
  'Gesamteinkommen 2025' AS source,
  COALESCE(category, 'Needs review') AS target,
  ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS amount_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE
  booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND amount < 0
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(category, 'Needs review')
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Gesamteinkommen 2025',
  'Nicht ausgegeben / verbleibend',
  ROUND(t.income - t.spending, 2)
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'Income' AND amount > 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS income,
    -SUM(CASE WHEN amount < 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS spending
  FROM transaction_view
  WHERE
    booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
) AS t
WHERE
  t.income - t.spending > 0
LIMIT 200
notes: request: Flussdiagramm (Flow/Sankey) für das Jahr 2025: Wie fließt das Gesamteinkommen (alle Einnahmen von 2025-01-01 bis 2025-12-31, Kategorie Income mit ihren Unterkategorien) in die Ausgabe-Kategorien? Quelle links = Gesamteinkommen 2025, Ziele rechts = je eine Kategorie der Ausgaben mit ihrem Aufwärtswert; zusätzlich einen Rest "Nicht ausgegeben / verbleibend", falls das Einkommen größer ist als die Summe der Ausgaben. Beträge in EUR, Zeitraum nur 2025.
